name: Corki
title: The Daring Bombardier

passive.name: Hextech Munitions

description.normalized: Hextech Shrapnel: Attacks and Spellblade deal 16% bonus true damage. The Package: After hitting enemy champions 6 times with Missile Barrage, The Package is delivered to Corki. He can pick it up to gain 4 Big Ones. The Package despawns after 15 seconds.

The Package: After hitting enemy champions 6 times with Missile Barrage, The Package is delivered to Corki. He can pick it up to gain 4 Big Ones. The Package despawns after 15 seconds.

q.name: Phosphorus Bomb

description.normalized: Fires a bomb, dealing 65 / 125 / 185 / 245 (+125% bonus AD +80% AP) magic damage and granting vision over the area.

q.rawParsedText: Fires a bomb, dealing 65 / 125 / 185 / 245 (+125% bonus AD +80% AP) magic damage and granting vision over the area.

w.name: Valkyrie

description.normalized: Flies a short distance, leaving a burning trail for 2.5 seconds. The trail burns enemies in it for 60 (+60% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage per second, dealing up to 150 / 250 / 350 / 450 magic damage.

w.rawParsedText: Flies a short distance, leaving a burning trail for 2.5 seconds. The trail burns enemies in it for 60 (+60% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage per second, dealing up to 150 / 250 / 350 / 450 magic damage.

e.name: Gatling Gun

description.normalized: Fires a gatling gun, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 (+55% bonus AD) physical damage per second, up to a total of 100 / 160 / 220 / 280 physical damage over 4 seconds. Shreds up to 10 / 14 / 18 / 22 Armor and Magic Resist for 2 seconds.

r.name: Missile Barrage

description.normalized: Fires a missile that explodes on the first target hit, dealing 70 / 140 / 210 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies. Big One: Every third missile is a Big One that deals 140 / 210 / 280 (+140% bonus AD) physical damage and has a bigger area of effect and increased blast radius. Charge: Gains a charge every 16 seconds, storing up to 4 charges. Attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by 2 (+300% Crit Rate) seconds on hit.
